title.narrative: Promoting Women in Science and STEM in Pakistan

description.narrative: UNESCO will promote the participation, visibility, and leadership of women and girls in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) in Pakistan. The initiative will support advocacy, awareness raising, mentoring, and science outreach activities aimed at encouraging greater engagement of women and girls in scientific education, research, innovation, and leadership. It will foster greater recognition of the contributions of women scientists, promote gender-responsive approaches within science ecosystems, and contribute to building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive scientific community. The initiative will also support science literacy and strengthen public awareness of the role of science, technology, and innovation in addressing sustainable development challenges.
